notes.title: Detective Instinct is participating in Steam Next Fest Feb 24-Mar 3!
notes.content:
We will be participating in Steam Next Fest this week with an updated demo!

New features include:
- Japanese language support 🇯🇵
- Aesthetic upgrades 👁️
- Added ending cinematic 🎞️

If you haven't check out our demo yet, there's no better time than now! :D

notes.title: Detective Instinct Demo updated to version 1.2!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44764729/872c776ab7b1f6ef3aeccc46e6a19229a00aa3cd.png[/img]

To coincide with [i]Detective Instinct[/i]'s participation in the [url=https://indiex.online/]2024 Indie X showcase[/url], we have [b]updated our demo[/b] with some heavily requested features, as well as a few more refinements. They are as follows:

[list]
[*] [b]"Restore Submenu" option[/b] has been added to the Options Menu. This keeps the player in a submenu when text finishes writing instead of reverting them back to the root menu (so, if you're looking at various options inside of the "Talk" command, you will still be looking at those options when control returns to the command menu).
[*] In most cases, [b]the player will no longer be reverted back to the root menu after investigating a spot in the background[/b]; they will instead remain in the investigation state until they choose to back out of it with the cancel button.
[*] Some small updates have been made to the writing for increased clarity.
[*] Some of the pixel art and animations have been refined.
[/list]

If you haven't tried the demo yet, there's never been a better time! And we're still collecting feedback, so if you'd like to have your voice heard about other things we may be missing, feel free to give the demo a shot and submit a feedback response form here (the link can also be found in game): https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfIaCvm5fN8mG9TAdeqAbMsqPj7cjhjvdyvm3_cqJOGbCxJfw/viewform?usp=sf_link


Thank you!
Joey, Armonica LLC
